output: html_document

## Gamma

```{r}
alpha <- 4
lambda <- 3
x <- seq(0, 5, length.out = 500)
plot(x, dgamma(x, shape = alpha, rate = lambda), type = "l",
     xlab = "x", ylab = "densidad")
pgamma(2, shape = alpha, rate = lambda)
qgamma(0.95, shape = alpha, rate = lambda)
```

## Weibull y confiabilidad

```{r}
k <- 2
eta <- 1000
pweibull(1200, shape = k, scale = eta, lower.tail = FALSE)

hazard <- function(x, k, eta) (k/eta) * (x/eta)^(k-1)
curve(hazard(x, 2, 1000), from = 1, to = 2000,
      xlab = "x", ylab = "h(x)")
```

## Beta

```{r}
a <- 5
b <- 2
pbeta(0.8, shape1 = a, shape2 = b, lower.tail = FALSE)
curve(dbeta(x, a, b), from = 0, to = 1,
      xlab = "x", ylab = "densidad")
```

## Simulación

```{r}
set.seed(2026)
xg <- rgamma(50000, shape = 4, rate = 3)
xw <- rweibull(50000, shape = 2, scale = 1000)
xb <- rbeta(50000, 5, 2)

c(mean(xg), var(xg))
c(mean(xw), var(xw))
c(mean(xb), var(xb))
```

## Actividad

Modifica los parámetros de forma y escala y compara cómo cambian la asimetría, dispersión y concentración de cada distribución.
